title: Comparing Options
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Comparar opciones es una habilidad esencial para tomar decisiones de negocios.

parts.visual:
Para decir que dos cosas son iguales usamos: AS + adjetivo + AS. 
Ej: Our product is AS GOOD AS theirs (Nuestro producto es tan bueno como el de ellos). 
Negativo: NOT AS... AS (No tan... como). 
Ej: This laptop is NOT AS FAST AS the other one.
parts.audio: To say two things are equal, we use: As, plus adjective, plus as. For example: Our product is as good as theirs. The negative is: Not as, plus adjective, plus as. For example: This laptop is not as fast as the other one.

parts.visual:
Para decir que algo es más, usamos: MORE + adjetivo largo + THAN. O añadimos -ER a los adjetivos cortos. 
Ej: Option A is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN Option B. 
Option B is CHEAPER THAN Option A. 
Para decir 'menos': LESS + adjetivo + THAN.
parts.audio: To say something is more, we use MORE plus a long adjective plus THAN. Or we add E-R to short adjectives. For example: Option A is more expensive than Option B. Option B is cheaper than Option A. To say less, we use: Less plus adjective plus than.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de comparar opciones.

questions.question: This printer is ____ that one. (Tan rápida como).
Our new software is ____ the old version. (Más eficiente que).
questions.explanation: 'Efficient' es un adjetivo largo -> more efficient than.

questions.question: The second option is ____ than the first one. (Más barata).
This marketing campaign was ____ than the last one. (Menos exitosa).
questions.explanation: Menos... que = Less + adjetivo + than (less successful).

questions.question: His presentation wasn't ____ yours. (Tan buena como).
questions.explanation: Not as good as = no tan buena como.

questions.question: Working from home is ____ than commuting every day. (Mejor).
This quarter's results are ____ than we expected. (Peores).
Which supplier is ____? (Más confiable).
Company A is not ____ Company B. (Tan grande como).
Traveling by train is ____ traveling by plane. (Menos estresante que).
The meeting was ____ than I thought. (Más larga).
Is the new office ____ the old one? (Tan espaciosa como).
Their offer is ____ ours. (Tan competitiva como).
This year is going to be ____ than last year. (Más difícil).
Our service is ____ the competitor's. (Más rápido que).
I have ____ experience than he does. (Menos).
questions.explanation: Less (menos) para cosas incontables como la experiencia.

questions.question: The CEO's speech was ____ than usual. (Más inspirador).
That decision was ____ than we realized. (Peor).
This problem is not ____ it seems. (Tan simple como).
We need to work ____ than before. (Más inteligentemente - Comparativo de smart).
It is ____ good as ours. (Tan)
It is ____ expensive than ours. (Más)
It is ____ successful than ours. (Menos)
It is better ____ theirs. (Que)
Not ____ fast as a train. (Tan)
This is ____ than that. (Mejor - irregular de good)
This is ____ than that. (Peor - irregular de bad)
Our price is ____ than theirs. (Más bajo - low + er)
It is ____ reliable than the old one. (Más)
Is it as big ____ the other office? (Como)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase que compara opciones.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our product is as good as theirs.
options: Our product is as good as theirs.
Our product is good as theirs.
Our product is better than theirs.
Their product is as good as ours.
questions.correct_answer: Our product is as good as theirs.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: This laptop is not as fast as the other one.
options: This laptop is not as fast as the other one.
This laptop is as fast as the other one.
This laptop is faster than the other one.
The other laptop is not as fast.
questions.correct_answer: This laptop is not as fast as the other one.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Option A is more expensive than Option B.
options: Option A is more expensive than Option B.
Option B is more expensive than Option A.
Option A is as expensive as Option B.
Option A is less expensive than Option B.
questions.correct_answer: Option A is more expensive than Option B.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Option B is cheaper than Option A.
options: Option B is cheaper than Option A.
Option A is cheaper than Option B.
Option B is cheap as Option A.
Option B is less cheap than Option A.
questions.correct_answer: Option B is cheaper than Option A.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: The meeting was longer than I thought.
The meeting is longer than I thought.

The meeting was shorter than I thought.
questions.correct_answer: The meeting was longer than I thought.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: The results are worse than we expected.

The results are bad as we expected.
